{{Short description|Greek physicist}}
'''Emmanuel Stratakis''' is a Greek physicist.

Stratakis earned his bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees in physics from the [[University of Crete]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Dr. Stratakis Emmanuel |url=https://www.iesl.forth.gr/en/people/stratakis-emmanuel |access-date=7 May 2022 |publisher=Foundation for Research and Technology—Hellas}}</ref> He works for the Institute of Electronic structure and laser, a division of the Foundation for Research and Technology—Hellas.<ref>{{cite news |title=Emmanuel Stratakis |url=http://stratakislab.iesl.forth.gr/team/emmanuel-stratakis/ |access-date=7 May 2022 |publisher=Foundation for Research and Technology—Hellas}}</ref> Stratakis was elected as a member of the 2022 class of fellows for [[Optica (society)|Optica]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Optica Announces Its 2022 Fellows Class |url=https://www.optica.org/en-us/about/newsroom/news_releases/2021/optica_announces_its_2022_fellows_class/ |access-date=7 May 2022 |publisher=Optica |date=18 November 2021 }} {{cite news |title=Optica Announces Its 2022 Fellows Class |url=https://www.oejournal.org/index/news/2517 |access-date=7 May 2022 |publisher=Opto-Electronic Journals Group |date=19 November 2021 |archive-date=15 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231115155659/https://www.oejournal.org/index/news/2517 |url-status=dead }} {{cite news |title=FORTH-IESL Researcher Dr. Emmanuel Stratakis elected Fellow of Optica |url=https://www.forth.gr/en/news/show/&tid=2074 |access-date=7 May 2022 |publisher=Foundation for Research and Technology–Hellas |date=9 December 2021 }}</ref> He is currently an Ambassador for the [[European Innovation Council]] for the years 2021-2027.<ref>{{Cite web |title=EIC Ambassadors (2021 – 2027) |url=https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-ambassadors-2021-2027_en |access-date=31 July 2022 |website=European Innovation Council}}</ref>
